title: PLAYER 2 PICKS A CHARACTER LIKE PLAYER 1
why: His order of 2026-10-03: the second window played one hidden save chosen for it, with no character selection and no way to play that character in 1 PLAYER. Now the player 2 window shows the same saves list: pick a character or create one. It plays a numbered save like any window, never the one player 1 has open (the two windows share storage), each window keeps its own pointer, and the old hidden player 2 save moves into a free slot once, so that character can be played in 1 PLAYER. Either window greys the save the other holds: IN USE BY PLAYER 1 or 2.
now: Player 2 now picks a character from the same saves list as player 1 (or creates one), and every character can be played in 1 PLAYER. The save the other window has open shows as IN USE.
